headings.title: Code compliance and seal required for sales
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits renting, leasing, selling, or offering new manufactured homes made after January 1, 1974, without code compliance and proper seal.

headings.title: Compliance seal required for in-state manufacturing
headings.reviewNote: Bars manufacturing manufactured homes or modular units in Missouri for rent, lease, or sale without a seal evidencing code compliance.

headings.title: Exemption for units manufactured for export
headings.reviewNote: Exempts manufactured homes and modular units built expressly for export and sold for use solely outside Missouri unless otherwise required by federal law or regulations.

headings.title: Code compliance and seal required for modular units
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits renting, leasing, or selling new modular units or educational units made after January 1, 1974, without compliance and commission seal.

headings.title: Mandatory ANSI standards for recreational vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits sales of new recreational vehicles or park trailers not manufactured in compliance with ANSI A119.2 or A119.5 standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.015 covering code compliance seals, export exemptions, modular units, and ANSI standards.

headings.title: Exemption from local and agency building codes
headings.reviewNote: Preempts state agencies and political subdivisions from imposing other building, plumbing, heating, or electrical codes on units bearing seals.

headings.title: Preemption of local codes and inspection programs
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits state agencies and political subdivisions from enforcing conflicting codes or establishing inspection programs for recreational vehicles.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.035 providing code preemption for sealed manufactured homes, modular units, and recreational vehicles.

headings.title: Commission inspection authority and representative systems
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission, through its own or approved public or private inspection services, to perform sufficient inspections of manufacturing and dealer premises and units, and permits examining manufacturer books and technical records.

headings.title: Fee establishment and Manufactured Housing Fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs establishment of fees deposited in the Manufactured Housing Fund to pay salaries and administrative expenses.

headings.title: Nonlapse terms and general revenue transfers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits fund transfers to general revenue unless biennial balances exceed twice the preceding year's appropriation.

headings.title: Appointment of department administrative personnel
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to appoint employees necessary for administering statutory manufactured housing provisions.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority and statutory nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to promulgate rules under chapter 536, voids pre-August 28, 1999 rulemaking delegations (without repealing compliant prior rules), and sets nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 1999.

headings.title: Authority to remove compliance seals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to remove seals from manufactured homes or modular units made in violation of section 700.045.

headings.title: Contracts and agreements with federal housing agency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes contracts and agreements necessary to comply with federal HUD statutes and regulations.

headings.title: Manufacturer and dealer reporting under federal act
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to require manufacturers and dealers to file reports required under the National Manufactured Housing Act of 1974.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.040 governing commission powers, inspections, fund creation, rulemaking, seal removal, and HUD agreements.

headings.title: Establishment of Manufactured Housing Consumer Recovery Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Manufactured Housing Consumer Recovery Fund in the state treasury administered by the public service commission.

headings.title: Payment of claims and advisory committee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes claim disbursements after exhaustion of legal remedies and creates a volunteer advisory committee to evaluate claims.

headings.title: Nonlapse terms and maximum fund balance
headings.reviewNote: Exempts fund balances from lapsing to general revenue, caps total balance at thirty-two percent of annual fund appropriations, and allows transfers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.041 establishing the recovery fund, claim procedures, advisory committee, and financial caps.

headings.title: Duty of owner to anchor manufactured home
headings.reviewNote: Requires owners to secure manufactured homes with anchors and tiedowns to resist wind forces, unless attached to permanent structures.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking for anchoring and tiedown standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to promulgate rules establishing minimum manufacturing and installation standards for anchors and tiedowns.

headings.title: Insurer anchoring verification and coverage obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires windstorm insurers to verify proper anchoring and prevents denial of coverage if unanchored damage occurs on insured homes.

headings.title: Private right of action for nonconforming installation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil actions for actual, punitive, and equitable relief against persons manufacturing or installing nonconforming anchoring devices.

headings.title: Application of merchandising practices law to violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of anchoring and tiedown provisions as unlawful merchandising practices under section 407.020.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.076 covering owner anchoring duties, commission standards, insurer rules, civil liability, and merchandising violations.

headings.title: Mandatory registration of manufacturers and dealers
headings.reviewNote: Requires every manufacturer and dealer selling or offering manufactured homes or modular units in Missouri to register each business location.

headings.title: Manufacturer registration application and fee requirements
headings.reviewNote: Specifies application contents, tax compliance proof, and initial seven hundred fifty dollar registration fee for manufacturers.

headings.title: Dealer registration application and fee requirements
headings.reviewNote: Outlines application contents, motor vehicle dealer compliance, and initial two hundred dollar fee for dealer registration.

headings.title: Annual renewal terms and renewal fee amounts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a one-year registration period and sets annual renewal fees at seven hundred fifty dollars for manufacturers and two hundred dollars for dealers.

headings.title: Authority to stagger registration renewal dates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to stagger registration renewal dates across the year to ensure balanced administrative workflow.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.090 covering manufacturer and dealer registration, fees, renewal periods, and staggered schedules.

headings.title: Established place of business requirements for dealers
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers, on or before January fifteenth annually, to apply for registration or renewal and maintain a bona fide established place of business with a permanent enclosed building where records are kept.

headings.title: Business address and records inspection requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates inclusion of physical street addresses and telephone numbers where books and records are maintained for daytime inspection.

headings.title: Additional information to determine dealer qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to require additional information to assess whether an applicant is a bona fide dealer of good moral character.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of registration and fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires assigning a certificate of registration to each dealer upon payment of the two hundred dollar registration or renewal fee; source footnote notes "of" appears in original rolls for "or".

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.095 governing dealer place of business standards, records inspection, and registration certificate issuance.

headings.title: Monthly reports and inspection of dealer records
headings.reviewNote: Requires registered dealers to submit monthly reports and permit inspection of invoices, titles, affidavits, assignments, and disclosures.

headings.title: Definition of authorized law enforcement officials
headings.reviewNote: Defines law enforcement officials authorized to inspect records to include the attorney general, prosecutors, highway patrol, sheriffs, and peace officers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.096 covering dealer monthly reporting, record inspections, and definitions of law enforcement officials.

headings.title: Commission authority to sanction dealer registrations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to refuse, suspend up to thirty days, or revoke dealer registrations after notice and hearing, subject to appeal.

headings.title: Prohibition against operating as unregistered dealer
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful for any person to act or hold themselves out as a manufactured home or modular unit dealer without registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.098 covering administrative sanctions against dealer registrations and prohibitions on unregistered operations.

headings.title: Notice of refusal and right to appeal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registration refusal for statutory noncompliance and requires written notice within thirty days detailing appeal rights.

headings.title: Consideration of complaints and administrative discipline
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to consider filed complaints as grounds for suspension, revocation, or probation of a manufacturer or dealer.

headings.title: Specific statutory grounds for disciplinary action
headings.reviewNote: Lists specific grounds for discipline including warranty noncompliance, sales tax delinquency, setup notice failure, and tied financing.

headings.title: Discipline across commonly owned or controlled registrants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes extending disciplinary sanctions to all registrations held or controlled by the same person upon finding consistent violation patterns.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.100 governing refusal notice, complaint handling, specific disciplinary grounds, and common-ownership sanctions.

headings.title: Surrender of manufacturer certificate of origin
headings.reviewNote: Outlines application procedures and documentation for surrendering a certificate of origin when a home is permanently affixed to real estate.

headings.title: Surrender of certificate of title for affixed home
headings.reviewNote: Details requirements for surrendering an existing certificate of title and securing lien releases when converting a home to real property.

headings.title: Application for confirmation of conversion to real estate
headings.reviewNote: Provides procedures for obtaining confirmation of conversion where certificates were surrendered or unissued, treating the home as real estate.

headings.title: Application for new title upon severance from land
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedures for issuing a new certificate of title when a previously affixed manufactured home is severed from real estate.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and standardized real estate forms
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of revenue to adopt rules and standard forms for affixation, severance, and conversion confirmations.

headings.title: Effective date for surrender and conversion provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the surrender, conversion, and severance provisions become effective no later than March 1, 2011.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.111 covering surrender of origin and title certificates, conversion confirmation, severance, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Merchandising practices violations and registration revocation
headings.reviewNote: Deems statutory violations to be merchandising practices violations and authorizes attorney general petitions to revoke registrations.

headings.title: Civil penalties and maximum liability limitations
headings.reviewNote: Imposes civil penalties up to one thousand dollars per violation and up to one million dollars annually for related series of violations.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for willful health or safety violations
headings.reviewNote: Makes knowing and willful violations threatening purchaser health or safety punishable by fine up to one thousand dollars, imprisonment, or both.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.115 establishing merchandising practices remedies, civil penalty limits, and criminal sanctions.

headings.title: Mandatory application for certificate of title and fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufactured home owners to apply for certificates of title under motor vehicle titling procedures and fee schedules.

headings.title: Proof of sales tax payment and purchase price
headings.reviewNote: Mandates proof of sales tax payment or exemption prior to title issuance and defines purchase price for contract valuation.

headings.title: Transfer of survivorship title upon owner death
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer of title held with right of survivorship to surviving owners upon presenting proof of death and application.

headings.title: Transfer of tenancy in common title upon death
headings.reviewNote: Governs transfer of title held as tenants in common upon application by surviving owners and the deceased owner's legal representative.

headings.title: Title prohibition on affixed home lacking severance affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing a certificate of title for an affixed home unless an affidavit of severance has been recorded under section 442.015.

headings.title: Filing of recorded affixation and severance affidavits
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to file delivered affidavits of affixation and severance upon confirming genuineness.

headings.title: Maintenance of records for affixation and severance
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining records of filed affixation and severance affidavits detailing owner names, recording dates, and book and page numbers.

headings.title: Filing applications for certificate of origin surrender
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to file verified applications for surrender of manufacturer certificates of origin under section 700.111.

headings.title: Filing applications for certificate of title surrender
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to file verified applications for surrender of certificates of title under section 700.111.

headings.title: Filing applications for confirmation of conversion
headings.reviewNote: Mandates filing verified applications for confirmation of conversion of affixed homes under section 700.111.

headings.title: Recordkeeping for surrendered certificates of origin
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining comprehensive records of manufacturer certificates of origin surrendered under section 700.111.

headings.title: Recordkeeping for surrendered certificates of title
headings.reviewNote: Directs the maintenance of records documenting certificates of title accepted for surrender under section 700.111.

headings.title: Recordkeeping for accepted confirmations of conversion
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to maintain records of all accepted applications for confirmation of conversion.

headings.title: Delivery and trust status of certificate of origin
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes delivering certificates of origin to facilitate transactions and imposes trust obligations on the recipient.

headings.title: Certificate of title as prima facie evidence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that a department certificate of title is prima facie evidence of facts stated thereon regardless of affixation to real estate.

headings.title: Lienholder consent required to alter title names
headings.reviewNote: Requires an owner adding or deleting names on a title application inconsistently with the notice of lien to provide the director with documentation evidencing the lienholder's authorization.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.320 governing title applications, sales tax, survivorship, affixation and surrender filings, and records.

headings.title: Definition of manufactured home for lien perfection
headings.reviewNote: Incorporates the definition of manufactured home from section 400.9-102(a)(53) for sections 700.350 to 700.390; source footnote notes section 700.390 was repealed in 2002.

headings.title: Perfection required for validity against subsequent parties
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates unperfected liens against subsequent transferees and lienholders who take interest without knowledge.

headings.title: Notice of lien delivery and purchase money perfection
headings.reviewNote: Establishes lien perfection through notice delivery to the director of revenue and sets thirty-day relation-back and purchase money rules.

headings.title: Lien perfection procedures on refinancing
headings.reviewNote: Governs lien perfection on refinanced loans secured by manufactured homes through delivery of refinancing notices of lien.

headings.title: Perfection and notation of future advance liens
headings.reviewNote: Permits liens to secure future advances when stated on the security agreement, noted in the notice of lien, and noted on the certificate of ownership (source text refers to "motor vehicle or trailer" if subject to one lien).

headings.title: Choice of law governing multi-state lien attachment
headings.reviewNote: Specifies multi-jurisdiction choice of law and perfection grace periods when manufactured homes enter Missouri from other jurisdictions.

headings.title: Security procedures for electronic notices and verifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to adopt security procedures using algorithms, encryption, or callback verification for electronic lien filings.

headings.title: Validity of prior lien transactions and UCC alignment
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the validity of lien transactions perfected under sections 700.350 to 700.390 after June 30, 2001, and before August 28, 2002, under section 400.9-303; source footnote notes section 700.390 was repealed in 2002.

headings.title: Continuation of perfected security interest priority
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the priority and validity of perfected security interests and prohibits cancelling origin or title certificates while liens exist.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.350 governing lien perfection, notice filings, refinancing, future advances, electronic security, and priority.

headings.title: Delivery of certificate of title to owner
headings.reviewNote: Directs mailing or electronic transmission of certificates of title to owners, with confirmation provided to lienholders.

headings.title: Lienholder election for electronic certificate retention
headings.reviewNote: Permits lienholders to elect department retention of electronic certificates of ownership pursuant to director regulations.

headings.title: Definition of electronic certificate of ownership
headings.reviewNote: Defines electronic certificate of ownership as any electronic record of ownership, title, or recorded liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.355 governing delivery of title certificates, lienholder electronic retention elections, and definitions.

headings.title: Owner duties upon creating lien and subordinate perfection
headings.reviewNote: Requires owners creating liens to execute applications and deliver titles, and sets procedures for subordinate lienholders to perfect interests.

headings.title: Perfection rules after permanent real estate affixation
headings.reviewNote: Governs perfection and termination of security interests under real property law after recording affidavits of affixation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.360 governing owner duties upon creating liens, subordinate perfection, and affixation effects.

headings.title: Assignment of lien or encumbrance by lienholder
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes lienholders to assign liens without affecting owner interests, protecting third parties lacking notice.

headings.title: Optional perfection by assignee on physical title
headings.reviewNote: Allows assignees to deliver assignments to the director to have new certificates issued naming them as lienholders.

headings.title: Notice of assignment for electronically retained certificates
headings.reviewNote: Sets procedures for notifying the director of lien assignments when certificates of ownership are electronically retained.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.365 covering lien assignments, optional assignee perfection, and electronic assignment notices.

headings.title: Lienholder duty to release satisfied lien
headings.reviewNote: Requires lienholders to execute releases within ten days of demand on certificates, separate forms, or electronically, and deliver to owners.

headings.title: Release notification for electronically retained certificates
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written notification within ten business days to the director upon releasing liens on electronically retained titles.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.370 governing mandatory lienholder releases upon satisfaction and electronic release notices.

headings.title: Liens excluded from statutory perfection provisions
headings.reviewNote: Excludes service supplier liens, government tax liens, and security interests in dealer inventory from statutory title perfection rules.

headings.title: Exclusivity of lien perfection methods and UCC transition
headings.reviewNote: Declares statutory lien perfection methods exclusive for manufactured homes not in dealer inventory, noting pre-August 2002 UCC filings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.375 covering statutory lien exclusions, exclusive perfection methods, and UCC transition rules.

headings.title: Application and documentation for repossession title
headings.reviewNote: Outlines requirements for secured creditors repossessing manufactured homes to apply for repossession certificates of ownership.

headings.title: Mandatory advance notice to owners and lienholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires ten days' first-class mailed written notice to owners and other lienholders before applying for a repossessed title, or permits including the information in an alternative UCC notice under section 400.9-613 or 400.9-614; source footnote notes "sections" appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Fee payment and issuance of repossession title
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to issue a repossessed certificate of ownership upon verification and payment of a ten dollar fee.

headings.title: Issuance of title when debtor title is absent
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuance of repossession titles and collection of unpaid taxes and fees when no prior debtor certificate exists.

headings.title: Director rulemaking authority for repossession titling
headings.reviewNote: Permits the director of revenue to prescribe rules under chapter 536 and section 536.028 if applicable, with nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2006.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.385 governing repossession title applications, debtor notices, title issuance, and rulemaking.

headings.title: Mandatory notification to county assessor upon transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of revenue to notify county assessors when sales tax is paid or titles to manufactured homes are transferred.

headings.title: Definition of manufactured home for assessor notification
headings.reviewNote: Directs that the term manufactured home has the meaning provided in section 700.010 for county assessor notifications.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.500 requiring director notice to county assessors upon home titling or transfers and defining terms.

headings.title: Real property owner lien for unpaid rent
headings.reviewNote: Creates a statutory lien for unpaid rent against an unencumbered manufactured home abandoned on rented real property.

headings.title: Mandatory written notice of abandonment and lien claim
headings.reviewNote: Specifies mandatory contents of written certified mail notices from landowners claiming abandonment and rent liens.

headings.title: Calculation of lien amount from accrued rental debt
headings.reviewNote: Defines the lien amount as unpaid rent accrued under the rental agreement until redemption or sale of the home.

headings.title: Prohibition on removing home prior to rent payment
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits manufactured home owners from removing homes from leased real property until all accrued rent is fully paid.

headings.title: Application for lien title following thirty-day default
headings.reviewNote: Permits property owners to apply for certificates of title to enforce liens if rent is unpaid after thirty days and uncontested.

headings.title: Contents and affidavit required for lien title application
headings.reviewNote: Details required components of lien title applications, including serial numbers, abandonment affidavits, notices, and lease contracts.

headings.title: Director verification and issuance of lien title
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to issue a certificate of ownership captioned lien title upon verifying application documents.

headings.title: Mandatory commencement of sale proceedings and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires lien title holders to begin sale proceedings within thirty days and authorizes recovery of title expenses and legal fees.

headings.title: Twenty-day advance notice requirements prior to sale
headings.reviewNote: Establishes notice requirements at least twenty days prior to sale by personal delivery, registered mail, newspaper publication, or handbills.

headings.title: Standard statutory form for public sale notice
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes the exact statutory text and disclosure items required for published or posted notices of public sale.

headings.title: Homeowner right of redemption prior to sale
headings.reviewNote: Allows manufactured home owners to redeem homes before sale by paying all accrued rent, legal fees, and advertising costs.

headings.title: Conduct of public sale and distribution of proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs public sales and orders proceeds distributed first to rent and expenses, with surplus paid to owners or deposited with the county treasurer.

headings.title: County treasurer escrow and three-year reclamation period
headings.reviewNote: Directs county treasurers to credit excess sale proceeds to general revenue, subject to owner reclamation within three years.

headings.title: Penalty for failure to remit excess sale proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Imposes liability for double the excess sale proceeds against lienors failing to remit excess funds and sworn statements within thirty days.

headings.title: Statutory bar against subsequent property damage claims
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that landowner compliance with statutory procedures operates as a perpetual bar against subsequent conversion or damage suits.

headings.title: Authorization for real property owner to purchase home
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes real property owners to bid for and purchase abandoned manufactured homes at public lien sales.

headings.title: Exemption for manufactured homes converted to real estate
headings.reviewNote: Exempts manufactured homes classified as real estate under section 442.015 from abandoned home lien sale provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.527 governing landlord liens on abandoned homes, notice, lien titles, public sales, and proceeds.

headings.title: Homeowner petition in circuit court contesting lien
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes homeowners to contest abandonment liens by filing a petition in associate circuit court within ten days of notice mailing.

headings.title: Release of home upon posting surety bond
headings.reviewNote: Permits homeowners to secure the release of manufactured homes pending contest hearings by posting bond equal to accrued rent.

headings.title: Judicial determination of rent and judgment enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to determine unpaid rent, enter judgment, and enforce liens or apply posted bond proceeds accordingly.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.528 governing associate circuit court proceedings to contest landlord abandonment liens and bonds.

headings.title: Landowner lien on abandoned home with perfected lien
headings.reviewNote: Creates a landowner lien for accrued rent on abandoned homes subject to perfected third-party liens and requires written certified notice.

headings.title: Rent accrual and limits on lienholder liability
headings.reviewNote: Sets homeowner liability at unpaid rent through removal and caps perfected lienholder liability at rent accruing beginning thirty days after notice is mailed through removal, abated during any court injunction or stay.

headings.title: Prohibition on home removal pending rent satisfaction
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits owners and perfected lienholders from removing abandoned homes until all rental obligations accrued under the section are paid.

headings.title: Title issuance barred pending payment of accrued rent
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the director of revenue from issuing titles or repossession titles to perfected lienholders until all accrued rent is paid to landowners.

headings.title: Petition to contest abandonment and rent in court
headings.reviewNote: Permits the homeowner or perfected lienholder to petition the associate circuit court within ten days of notice mailing to contest the lien; source footnote notes "owe" appears in original rolls for "owes".

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.529 governing landowner liens on abandoned homes with perfected security interests and title restrictions.

headings.title: Definitions of manufactured home and land lease community
headings.reviewNote: Defines manufactured home, manufactured or mobile home land lease community, and mobile home for landlord eviction notice rules.

headings.title: Advance notice and rent freeze for land use change
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one hundred twenty days' written notice (or the longer remaining lease period) before evicting home-owning tenants for a land use change, and bars rent increases (except solely for property tax increases) during the sixty days before or any time after notice.

headings.title: Preservation of standard eviction notice for other causes
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that landlords retain authority to evict tenants with less than one hundred twenty days' notice for reasons other than land use changes.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.600 governing advance notice requirements for tenant evictions caused by changes in land use.

headings.title: Application for certificate of ownership in beneficiary form
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes sole owners and joint tenants with survivorship rights to request beneficiary-form certificates transferring title upon death.

headings.title: Prohibition of beneficiary designations for tenants in common
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing beneficiary-form certificates of ownership to persons holding interests as tenants in common.

headings.title: Required statutory wording for transfer-on-death designations
headings.reviewNote: Requires beneficiary certificates to include the words transfer on death to or abbreviation TOD followed by beneficiary names.

headings.title: Lifetime owner rights, revocation methods, and encumbrance priority
headings.reviewNote: Preserves lifetime owner rights, specifies exclusive methods for revoking beneficiaries, and subjects beneficiary interests to prior encumbrances.

headings.title: Title transfer upon owner death and nontestamentary status
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of new certificates to surviving owners or beneficiaries upon proof of death and clarifies nontestamentary character.

headings.title: Prohibition on beneficiary titles for affixed homes
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing beneficiary certificates of ownership for homes subject to recorded affixation affidavits lacking recorded severance affidavits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.630 governing beneficiary-form title applications, revocation, death transfers, and affixation limits.

headings.title: Title citation as Manufactured Home Installation Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates sections 700.650 to 700.692 as the Manufactured Home Installation Act.

headings.title: Definitions for manufactured home installation provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines nine terms (applicant, commission, dealer, installation, installation standards, installer, manufactured home, manufacturer, and person) for sections 700.650 to 700.692.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.650 establishing the act title and defining key installation terms.

headings.title: Mandatory state installer license requirement
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits engaging in the business or holding oneself out as a manufactured home installer without a commission license.

headings.title: Exclusivity of state license and local preemption
headings.reviewNote: Establishes commission installer licenses as exclusive and prohibits political subdivisions from requiring local installer licenses.

headings.title: Dealer and manufacturer licensed installer requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires dealers and manufacturers performing installations directly to employ at least one licensed installer.

headings.title: Supervising licensed installer required for legal entities
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that any corporation, partnership, or legal entity performing installations maintain at least one supervising licensed installer.

headings.title: Exemptions for self-installation and supervised agents
headings.reviewNote: Exempts homeowners installing on their own property for personal occupancy and direct agents working under licensee supervision.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.656 governing mandatory state installer licenses, local preemption, and business exemptions.

headings.title: General licensing criteria and examination requirements
headings.reviewNote: Establishes age, moral character, training program completion, examination passage, and fee requirements for installer licenses.

headings.title: Workers' compensation insurance for independent installers
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants who are not manufacturer or dealer agents to present proof of workers' compensation insurance coverage.

headings.title: General liability insurance for affiliated installer agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants who are dealer or manufacturer agents to show proof of at least three hundred thousand dollars in general liability coverage.

headings.title: License validity duration and renewal periods
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that installer licenses are valid for a term of not less than one year determined by the commission and subject to renewal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.659 covering installer licensing criteria, insurance requirements, and license duration.

headings.title: License renewal notices and continuing education
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to send renewal notices and requires licensees to fulfill renewal criteria, including continuing education.

headings.title: Notice of insurance cancellation and license suspension
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensees to report insurance cancellations within ten days and authorizes license suspension until coverage is restored.

headings.title: Voluntary inactive license status and limitations
headings.reviewNote: Allows licensees meeting standards to request inactive status provided they do not practice and maintain continuing education.

headings.title: Reissuance procedures for lapsed or suspended licenses
headings.reviewNote: Permits establishing procedures to reissue lapsed, expired, suspended, revoked, or inactive installer licenses, barring reissuance more than two years after expiration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.668 covering license renewal notices, insurance reporting, inactive status, and license reissuance.

headings.title: Prohibited acts and unauthorized installation practices
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates prohibited practices including false impersonation, presenting forged credentials, using suspended licenses, and uncertified practice.

headings.title: Criminal penalty classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of prohibited installation practices as class A misdemeanors.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.671 covering prohibited installer conduct, unlicensed practice, and misdemeanor criminal penalties.

headings.title: Commission authority to discipline installers and others
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to discipline an installer licensee, limited-use installer licensee, or any other person for violations of sections 700.671 and 700.674.

headings.title: Authorized disciplinary sanctions and corrective remedies
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates disciplinary actions including revocation, suspension, reexamination, probation, noncompliance notices, and license refusal.

headings.title: Investigation of complaints and disciplinary grounds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to consider complaints against installers as grounds for revocation, suspension, or probation.

headings.title: Notice of license refusal and appeal procedures
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written notification of refusal reasons, alternative dispute resolution options, formal complaint rights, and judicial review.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.677 governing disciplinary authority, sanction methods, complaints, and refusal notices.

headings.title: Mandatory commission investigation of installer complaints
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to investigate all complaints concerning installation violations to determine grounds for discipline or license refusal.

headings.title: Subpoena authority for witness testimony and records
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to issue subpoenas duces tecum to compel document production and witness attendance during investigations.

headings.title: Judicial restraining orders and writs of mandamus
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to petition the circuit court for restraining orders or writs of mandamus against statutory violators.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.680 governing complaint investigations, subpoena powers, and judicial enforcement petitions.

headings.title: Compliance with manufacturer installation instructions
headings.reviewNote: Requires installers to follow manufacturer instructions approved by HUD under the National Manufactured Housing Act.

headings.title: Commission adoption of uniform installation standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to adopt uniform standards covering foundations, supports, anchoring, underpinning, and section joining.

headings.title: Purchase and mandatory affixation of installation decals
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed installers to purchase decals from the commission and permanently affix them to completed home installations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.683 governing adherence to manufacturer instructions, state standards, and installation decals.

headings.title: Administrative implementation and independent contracting
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes implementation using commission staff, independent contractors under administration policy, or approved public/private entities.

headings.title: Establishment of fees and deposit in housing fund
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to establish reasonable fees to cover implementation costs and requires collecting and transmitting them to the department of revenue for deposit in the Manufactured Housing Fund.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority and statutory nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to promulgate rules under chapter 536 and section 536.028 if applicable, with nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2004.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 700.692 covering administrative implementation, fees, rulemaking powers, and nonseverability.
